projects.name: Greater Aligarh Integrated Township and ADA Affordable Housing Allotment
projects.description: Residential colony development in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh led by the Aligarh Development Authority under the UP Housing and Urban Planning Department and Aligarh Master Plan 2031. Covers the Greater Aligarh township of about 335 hectares (around 900 acres) near Khair Road and Raja Mahendra Pratap University in three phases, plus the August 2025 first-come first-served allotment of 172 EWS/LIG units. Precise consolidated sanctioned outlay is not published in official ADA notices; a figure around Rs 700 crore appears only in promotional videos and is unverified, so the budget below is an indicative planning figure only.
projects.ministryOrDept: Housing and Urban Planning Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sectorsOrPhases: Phase 1 - Khair Road sectors near Raja Mahendra Pratap University
Phase 2 - Greater Aligarh township expansion blocks

projects.name: Ganga Expressway Phase-1 (Meerut-Prayagraj) Construction
projects.description: 594-km access-controlled greenfield expressway from Meerut to Prayagraj executed by the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority under the UP Industrial Development framework. Phase-1 is divided into 12 construction packages with a reported project cost around Rs 37,350 crore, about 84 percent complete by mid-2025 and targeted for opening in late 2025. Balance works, toll systems and industrial-link interfaces continue.
